## alice-dms-language-backfill (PROJ-79)

One-time/repeatable manual backfill: checks every existing document across all six
classifiable Weaviate collections for suspected-English title/summary using the same
heuristic as alice-dms-language-check, and corrects hits on confirm.

**Trigger**: POST /webhook/alice-dms-language-backfill
**Dry-run** (no `confirm` param): pure local heuristic check against already-stored
title/summary values — no Ollama call, no writes. Reports hits (fileName, collection,
field, current value).
**Confirm** (`confirm=true`): for every dry-run hit, re-generates title/summary via the
shared alice-dms-language-check sub-workflow (same two-attempt German-forced logic as the
nightly fix) using the stored fullText/content, and PATCHes only title/summary/
languageUncertain on the existing Weaviate object — no collection change, no insert/delete,
no thumbnail regeneration (image reference is untouched).

**Locking**: shares the exact same Redis lock key as alice-dms-processor
(`alice:dms:processor:lock:run`) so it never competes for the Ollama/RTX 3090 resource.
**Batching**: same wall-clock time-limit pattern as alice-dms-classification-backfill
(7200s), resumable across multiple invocations/nights.

parameters.jsCode: return [{ json: { mode: 'error', error: 'alice-dms-language-backfill: lock busy — alice-dms-processor or another backfill run is currently active. Try again later.' } }];
